name: Candidate DEM-derived catchment - DEM outlet (candidate, unverified)

outlet.name: DEM outlet (candidate, unverified)
outlet.source: Catbalogan Water District, Kulador Treatment Plant page
outlet.sourceText: located 2.7 kilometers from Barangay San Andres of Catbalogan, Samar, or 110 48' 44.4" N and 240 54' 10.3" E. The plant receives water from the Antiao River through a spillway which is 16 meters wide and 1 meter tall.
outlet.note: The published coordinate is the Kulador Treatment Plant, not an intake. The plant takes water from the Antiao River through an intake box / spillway whose location is not verified. The pour point here is only the DEM channel cell nearest the plant coordinate (candidate, unverified), so this catchment must not be treated as the catchment of the Kulador intake.

method: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM -> Priority-Flood + epsilon -> D8 -> upstream cells of the snapped pour point -> polygon traced along cell edges (no smoothing)

relationToReserve.note: The reserve is the management context; only this catchment generates runoff in the model. The two areas are never added.
